semantic_fidelity.reason: All 14 directed geometric relations are present, but source-required identifiers/roles/limitations are dropped and three edge-label owners remain uncertain. Source/spec reveal confirms intent without curing capture ambiguity. See F1-F5; narrative ledgers are not same-view keys.

arrow_traceability.reason: All 14 source stems reach unique arrowheads in the correct direction; no extra visible link, crossing, shared corridor, false branch or bus requirement. Close nested runs and two same-route one-cell jogs remain followable. Three label-ownership failures are semantic failures, not ambiguous geometric destinations.

layout_fit.reason: Geometric fit passes: each ordinary/selected view is 77x47 at natural 100%, complete boxes and full displayed labels, no palette occlusion or clipping; headers, startup lines and ANSI grids agree. All 14 geometric relations are covered once with repeated split anchors. However the fixed gate also requires complete source coverage across splits: F1/F2 source identifiers/roles have no key or view, so the full conjunctive category fails on those same omissions (not an additional independent defect). This is omission, not clipping. Outer live-pane rectangle is unrecorded; live_pane=null.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Captures show guest VM/container amber, virtual bridges teal, host pink, overlay green and NIC pair blue in v1; related NICs are adjacent amber in v2 and Verizon ISP nodes adjacent teal in v3. These are source concepts, not depth alone. Source sequence is respected. Cross-view hue stability is explicitly not a gate.

border_integrity.reason: 16/16 node occurrences have complete sides/four corners and one ordinary per-node perimeter color; all 16/16 selected perimeters are continuously bold RGB(216,166,87). None uncheckable. Simultaneous select-all proves borders, not individual focus/drag interaction. Motion diagram bodies do not preserve ANSI colors; ordinary/selected ANSI independently provides required color evidence.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen skill/binary/rubric/dataset/source/expected/harness hashes, all 21 bundle artifact hashes and 8 attempt hashes were verified; exact viewer argv is in captured scrollback and check argv/stdout+stderr/exit are bound by the hash-verified capture harness plus manifest. DeepSeek generation and separate actual OpenAI Sol judge identities are recorded; blind record preceded reveal and its hash is unchanged. Final three panes have harness close/get records, and all six owned panes have generator cleanup records. App dimensions/startup lines satisfy the documented frozen pane-width harness limitation; no outer-pane rectangle is invented. No new viewer or chat art.

animation.reason: The frozen cases.json entry and expected.json both mark this case animation optional, and source.md contains no request for animation. Source-backed N/A therefore applies, not a pass. Unrequested dots do not damage stems, arrowheads, borders or labels in the samples. Two routes are stationary in-sample (e1 at (10,15), e14 at (37,32)); this is not evidence of successful motion and not a new required gate. Three other routes repeat short subsets; no observed multi-dot or hazard-cell violation. Full per-route positions are sealed in observed-first.md.

findings.description: Tailscale overlay address 100.113.153.49 is absent: the only overlay node says tailscale0, with no same-view address key. Source-required address meaning is dropped; the generator admits the omission. This is not clipping and not repaired by the JSON ledger.

Additional source identifiers/role meanings are erased: docker 172.18.2.1 is replaced by docker0 (the source does not establish that interface name); Verizon aggregation/edge 100.41.x becomes Verizon edge without its address/aggregation key; Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 / AS13335 becomes only AS13335. No same-view abbreviation key supplies the missing values or Cloudflare name.

Two v1 required link labels have uncertain visual owners, as sealed blindly: eno1 2.5 GbE is between the host-to-Wi-Fi run at row 31 and host-to-bond run at row 33; UDP encap sits just left of the host-to-bond down arrow at (29,34), not securely on the tailscale-to-bond horizontal at row 36. Reading the spec settles intent, not capture readability.

metric 600 at [32,20,10,1] begins immediately after the bond0/default-route bend at (31,20), while its intended wlp8s0 route is on row 21. The blind reader cannot securely assign the metric to the Wi-Fi backup rather than wired primary; the spec-only owner declaration does not preserve that source distinction visually.

Source-backed limitations and model roles are omitted or weakened: v6 ULA does not explicitly say ULA-only/no global IPv6/no IPv6 Internet; no view labels no committed rate, the collapsed ToR/spine/border/firewall role of the Fios router, or the demarc/MMR analogy. A node label or same-view text key can state these without inventing an edge. Bare group names in JSON and a generator narrative do not make those facts visible.
